truth_method: Ball centres read by eye on 3x gridded crops at 17 frames (377-436, every ~6 frames plus 430-436), each cross-checked by a purple-HSV blob fit; remaining 391-437 frames from a purple-blob chain seeded at 390 whose path agrees with every eye-read frame within 3 px; YOLO (conf 0.1) was a poor candidate source here (wrong blob at 389-395, misses 376-388). Lane quads are straight-line fits to bright-run lane edges on rows below the pins, extrapolated to the pin-base row; fl_* is the lowest row with both edges in frame, not the foul line. Board = rounded middle of edge-profile (f434/f436) and 7-10 pin-spacing ruler (f434/f436) reads, uncertainty = half their spread; the two methods disagree by ~4-5 boards: the edge lines put the right lane edge ~18 px (~10 in) right of the rightmost visible pin column, so the ruler (which assumes the outermost visible columns are the 7 and 10 pins) is the suspect read; a ball-diameter ruler measured from the edge line sides with the edge profile.
